stock.title: Stock
stock.text: What is in each warehouse now, at cost.
stock.search: Search by name, SKU or barcode
stock.empty_text: Receive goods to see them here.

items.title: Items
items.text: Everything you keep or sell, with its unit and price.
items.search: Search by name, SKU or barcode
items.empty_text: Add the goods you buy, keep and sell.
items.reorder_hint: Warn when stock falls to this.

documents.title: Receipts and issues
documents.text: Goods received, issued, moved between warehouses and adjusted.
documents.empty_text: Receive goods to start your stock.

help.receipt: Goods that came in: the supplier, their invoice number and what each unit cost.
help.issue: Goods that went out (used, sold outside the till, given away).
help.transfer: Goods sent to another warehouse: they leave now and arrive when received there.
help.adjustment: Stock found or lost (damage, theft, a mistake): a quantity below zero takes stock out. Say why.

document.scan: Scan a barcode or type a SKU, then Enter
document.saved: Saved. Check it, then post it.
document.waiting: Waiting for someone else to approve it; stock has not changed yet.

done.post: Posted. Stock is up to date.
done.dispatch: Sent off; it is on the way.
done.receive: Received. Anything missing was written off as a loss.

confirm.post_text: Stock changes now and it goes into the books. A posted document cannot be changed; a mistake is corrected with an adjustment.
confirm.dispatch_text: The goods leave this warehouse now and are on the way until received.
confirm.receive_text: Check the quantities that arrived; anything less than sent is a loss.
confirm.approve_text: Stock changes now and it goes into the books. Your name is recorded.
confirm.cancel_text: It stays on the list as cancelled; stock does not change.
confirm.delete_text: Nothing was posted; the draft goes.

bill.title: Supplier bill for this receipt
bill.text: A draft bill in Accounting at the costs received, clearing goods received not billed. Check the supplier's VAT there, then submit it.
bill.none: No suppliers yet. Add the supplier in Accounting → Parties first.
bill.billed: Billed: the supplier's bill is in Accounting.

line_errors.quantity: Give a quantity (this unit allows {decimals} decimals).
line_errors.unit_cost: Give the cost of one, like 120 or 120.50.
line_errors.batch: This item is tracked by batch: give the batch number.

counts.title: Stock counts
counts.text: Count what is on the shelf; the differences are posted once approved.
counts.open_text: What the books expect is taken now; count, then send it for approval.
counts.opened: Count started. Enter what you find.
counts.empty_text: Count a warehouse now and then to keep the books true.
counts.no_lines: Nothing to count. Scan an item to add it.

confirm.submit_text: {done} of {total} items counted; those not counted do not change.
confirm.approve_text: Each difference is posted as found or lost stock. Your name is recorded.

expiring.title: Expiring batches
expiring.text: Batches in stock that expire within {days} days, or already have.
expiring.empty_text: Batches near their expiry date show here.

setup.decimals_hint: 0 for pieces; 3 for kg or litres.

warehouses.title: Warehouses
warehouses.text: Where stock is kept; each belongs to a branch or department.
warehouses.empty_text: Add the store rooms and shops where you keep goods.

units.title: Units
units.text: How items are counted: pieces, kilograms, litres, boxes.
units.empty_text: Add the units your items are counted in.

categories.title: Categories
categories.text: Groups of items, for finding and counting them.
categories.empty_text: Group items, like Food, Toiletries, Stationery.

reports.title: Stock reports

help.valuation: Quantity and value of every item in each warehouse on a day.
help.reorder: Items at or below their reorder level, and how much to order. Print it as a shopping list.
help.slow: Stock that has not been sold, issued or sent on for a while: money sitting on the shelf.
help.ledger: Every move of one item between two days, with the balance after each.

reports.pick_item: Choose an item to see its ledger.

empty.slow: No slow movers: everything is moving

labels.title: Barcode labels
labels.text: Choose items and how many labels of each, then print on an A4 sheet or a label printer.
labels.empty: No items with a sale price
